classes.invariant: Every member is a predicative adjective of apprehension, used bare in these libraries ("I'm X about it", "my mum's X"), with no article site anywhere in the class and no member in any signal lexicon. Checked against fever_null_attribution and fever_null_hedged rather than against filler/emotional.txt, because those two are where an affect word does label work: "I assumed I was just anxious about the interview" attributes the symptom to nerves, and it attributes it to nerves equally under every swap. 'on edge' was dropped because the loader refuses a vowel-initial multi-word member unconditionally, and it occurred nowhere anyway. Accepted residual: 'worried sick' is a fixed collocation at three sites and the swap yields 'anxious sick'; shadowing it as a member costs more sites than it saves, so it is recorded instead.
